column7: The gRPC half of pat-restriction-ungated-writes-001: every unary write RPC whose handler makes no authorization call (derived from server/grpc/services' AST, transitively through package helpers) must be declared in core.restrictedPATUngatedWrites, and the auth interceptors refuse a restricted PAT from the same table (PermissionDenied + the sentinel text). Today the only ungated write RPC is BreakGlassService.ActivateBreakGlass, already refused in core by #3071, so the behavioural half is green on main; the declaration half was watched red by deleting its table entry ('ungated write RPC with no restricted-PAT declaration'). Guards against a new ungated write RPC landing undecided. PAT-GUARD-3
